programme.title: BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES [English Dub]
programme.desc: Na Hyun-jing, a charismatic female boss who turned a crime organization into a legal business enterprise, is planning to retire. However, her decision to break clean from the past is met with obstacles from inside and out. In addition, Dae-shik, a vindictive prosecutor who was coerced by Hyun-jung to help build up the gang’s business, plots a revenge. When the existence of Hyun-jung’s son is revealed, he instantly becomes the target of all her enemies.

programme.title: GLORY Kickboxing
programme.desc: Eight of the best and most exciting featherweights on the planet go head-to-head in a one-night tournament. GLORY featherweight champion Petch (170-40-3, 27 KO) goes up against former RISE champion Taiju Shiratori (30-10-1, 12 KO), the in-form Berjan Peposhi (30-4, 16 KO) takes on ‘The Korean Monster’ Sunghyun Lee (69-11-2, 17 KO), the always exciting Abraham Vidales (16-3, 13 KO) collides with current RISE champ Chadd Collins (63-17-2, 32 KO), and number one ranked GLORY featherweight Miguel Trindade (59-6, 24 KO) faces RISE great & former GLORY title contender Kento Haraguchi (26-4-1, 17 KO).

programme.desc: The 2024 DUPR Collegiate National Championship reaches a fever pitch in Dallas as the North Carolina Tar Heels and the Utah Tech Trailblazers meet for a legendary semifinal rematch of their 2022 title bout. With both teams deeply familiar with one another’s strategies, the atmosphere at Brookhaven Country Club is electric, featuring elite players like Sarah Carpenter and Avery Beck battling for every point. The high-intensity matches, including women’s and men’s doubles, push these athletes to their limits as they fight to avoid another heart-pounding "dream breaker" finish. This high-stakes showdown captures the pure spirit of collegiate pickleball, where technical precision and emotional resilience decide who advances to face the defending champions.

programme.title: Children of the Sun
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Los Pitufos
programme.desc: La vida no siempre es sencilla para Escrupuloso, el joven aprendiz del malvado mago Gargamel. Gargamel es un compañero hosco, malhumorado y cascarrabias en el mejor de los casos. Sin embargo, existe una fórmula mágica que garantiza convertir a las personas más desagradables en seres amables y afectuosos. Escrupuloso engaña a su maestro para que la beba… y, paradójicamente, ¡eso significa que la Aldea Pitufa se encuentra en mayor peligro que nunca!

programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: Spiders 3D
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: BROTHERHOOD OF BLADES [English Dub]
programme.desc: Na Hyun-jing, a charismatic female boss who turned a crime organization into a legal business enterprise, is planning to retire. However, her decision to break clean from the past is met with obstacles from inside and out. In addition, Dae-shik, a vindictive prosecutor who was coerced by Hyun-jung to help build up the gang’s business, plots a revenge. When the existence of Hyun-jung’s son is revealed, he instantly becomes the target of all her enemies.

Tom explains how a record‑low birth rate, a property slump that has erased years of housing gains, trillions of dollars in local hidden debt, the longest deflation stretch in modern Chinese history, and youth unemployment north of 20 percent add up to an economy with serious structural challenges. This is the China the headlines rarely unpack, and it matters for anyone trying to understand global competition with the US.
